(2) Exact-deduplicate by hash of whitespace-normalised text (keep first copy), and drop docs under 200 chars. (3) Rank docs by score, count tokens with tiktoken gpt2 (encode_ordinary_batch), and keep the top-scoring docs until the kept set reaches T tokens or the score drops below 0.5, whichever comes first (if fewer than T tokens pass, just return that smaller set and let the trainer cycle it rather than padding with off-domain text). why: The pool is roughly half spam, code, forum and other off-domain text while the target is clearly WikiText-style Wikipedia articles, so spending all T tokens on deduplicated target-like documents should cut bpb far more than any ordering tweak.
